digest.component_or_area: unit test AST guards / structural assertions
propositions: Four AST guards scan hardcoded source files that no longer contain the constructs they police after module refactors, causing them to pass unconditionally (findings 1-4)
Guards survive relocation only when they include explicit anti-vacuity assertions (e.g. test_acli_graph_pagination_heldout.py:630) proving scan population is non-empty
Findings 1-4 must be re-targeted to the actual module locations and gain coverage assertions; mutation tests confirm old guards are vacuous while repaired versions detect violations
Findings 5 and 7-8 are borderline or false positives requiring explicit disposition (fix, accept-with-reason, or reject)
Finding 6 uses relative pathlib.Path not anchored to __file__, breaking when cwd is not repo root
Repair pattern proven on bug 34c2: widen scan from single file to package, derive scan population instead of hardcoding filename, and add anti-vacuity assertion with named entity landmarks
